text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — AcmeCorp wants an air-gapped UAT POC. They asked for SOC2/ISO artefacts + a signed pen-test letter and a 48h testing window. They also need the SSH bastion access pattern, IP allowlist, and confirmation on whether Dedicated/on-prem packaging changes pricing. Can we pull the evidence together and confirm the network/pen-test scope?

Sarah Patel: Got it. For pen-test letter we use the standard template (legal-friendly). I'll prepare a draft and upload. Important: clarify whether they'll test only inside the customer's VPC (via our jump host) or hit any public endpoints we expose.

Mike Chen: From infra side: for air-gapped UAT we do a jump-host + ephemeral key model. We'll need the customer's bastion IPs and a named contact for coordination. We'll also need the exact CIDR ranges to allowlist.

Jordan Lee: For SOC2/ISO we can provide the SOC2 summary, control-matrix excerpt, and a redacted network diagram. We cannot hand over full reports, but we can provide an attestation letter + the evidence index.

Olivia Gomez: Pricing note: Dedicated single-tenant or on-prem packaging triggers an enterprise addon. If they want a true air-gapped on-prem POC there’s usually a one-time onboarding + adjusted monthly commit. Ballpark +15-25% depending on scope — I'll confirm with procurement.

sec-bot: Pen-test letter template: https://redwood.internal/security/pen-test-template.pdf :lock: (signed copy required before tests can start)

Alex Kim: Action items — please confirm: 1) Sarah upload pen-test draft for legal review; 2) Jordan bundle SOC2 artefacts (redacted where necessary); 3) Mike produce jump-host playbook + SSH key rotation snippet; 4) Olivia confirm pricing delta and include in the POC quote. Can we aim to have everything by EOW?

Sarah Patel: Uploaded draft: https://s3.redwood/cust-evidence/acme/pen_test_draft_v1.docx (presigned, expires in 48h). Tagged legal@ for review.

Mike Chen: Short jump-host playbook (for customer-facing docs):
``
# create ephemeral user
adduser poc_runner
mkdir /home/poc_runner/.ssh
chown poc_runner /home/poc_runner/.ssh
# drop public key
echo "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAACAQCu... customer-key" > /home/poc_runner/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 700 /home/poc_runner/.ssh
chmod 600 /home/poc_runner/.ssh/authorized_keys
# recommended: rotate keys every 24h during test window
```
We also need customer IP ranges + preferred test window.

Jordan Lee: SOC2 summary + control mapping uploaded: https://s3.redwood/cust-evidence/acme/soc2_summary_redacted.pdf — includes control IDs and evidence pointers.

Olivia Gomez: Quick pricing update: provisional quote for a 2-week dedicated POC with on-prem packaging requires procurement sign-off. I'll drop the provisional in #sales-demos and DM Alex. If they need extended support or a staged on-prem deployment, that will change the quote.

Alex Kim: Thanks — Sarah/Olivia/Mike/Jordan: please drop final links and tag me once legal signs the pen-test letter. I’ll coordinate scheduling with the customer's security lead (cc: @AcmeSec-contact).

Sarah Patel: Legal asked to add a clause about exfil proofing and a contact for coordination. I updated the draft and re-uploaded: https://s3.redwood/cust-evidence/acme/pen_test_draft_v2.docx

Mike Chen: Noted — will include an attacker-simulation holdback guidance in the runbook. Also confirm: do we block outbound internet from POC nodes? If yes, we need to know which update servers (eg. apt repos) to allow temporarily.

Jordan Lee: Customer asked for timeline for evidence delivery — we can deliver the SOC2 summary + network diagram within 24h of request; redacted evidence index will take 2 business days.

Olivia Gomez: I'll get procurement to fast-track a provisional pricing note. Sending DM to Alex now.

Alex Kim: Great. If legal approves the pen-test letter this week we can tentatively schedule the 48h window next Tue-Wed. Will update ACME contact and confirm the final IP allowlist. Thanks all.
